topic: ML API deployment and frequency clustering updates
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on updating the ML API, specifically regarding frequency clustering logic. It was determined that a new version of the ML API should be deployed to production (prod) and staging environments. The proposed update included removing unnecessary endpoints and ensuring the `get_frequency_clustered_ch` function used the same logic as the current stage environment.

Key actions involved merging changes from the `prod-update` branch into the main codebase, followed by deploying the updated version to production. A specific requirement was implemented: enabling frequency tracking via the API for Malaysia on prod and updating configuration settings to ensure Malaysian companies use facility-level aggregation when traffic pages are viewed without filters.
decisions: Deploy a new ML API version (from `prod-update`) to both production and staging environments.
The updated API should remove unnecessary endpoints and standardize the frequency clustering logic across environments.
Frequency tracking via the API must be enabled for Malaysia on prod.
Configuration settings must be updated to force Malaysian companies to use facility-level aggregation.
action_items: Merge changes from `prod-update` into main and deploy to production (and staging, if necessary).
Verify that the API is functioning correctly after deployment.
